### Entry Points

```bash
# Training
python main.py --config configs/paper_config.yaml [--seed 42] [--output results/]

# Standalone evaluation
python eval.py --config configs/paper_config.yaml [--results results/iter_N/] [--metric accuracy]

# Dry-run (M0 sanity check)
python main.py --config configs/paper_config.yaml --max_steps 10 --dry-run
```

## Configuration Schema

```yaml
# configs/paper_config.yaml — fill all values from paper
model:
  hidden_dim: ~           # [from paper Table X]
  num_layers: ~
  num_heads: ~
  dropout: ~

training:
  learning_rate: ~
  lr_schedule: ~          # cosine | step | constant
  warmup_steps: ~
  batch_size: ~
  epochs: ~
  optimizer: ~            # adamw | sgd | ...
  weight_decay: ~
  gradient_clip: ~
  seed: 42

data:
  train_path: data/processed/train
  val_path: data/processed/val
  test_path: data/processed/test
  num_workers: 4

eval:
  primary_metric: ~       # name of the main metric
```

## Runtime Artifacts

These are generated during reproduction and should NOT be committed:

| Path | Created by | Contents |
|------|-----------|----------|
| `logs/iter_N.log` | `/run-experiment` | Full stdout + stderr for iteration N |
| `results/iter_N/` | Training loop | Checkpoints, metric JSON, config snapshot |
| `results/best_checkpoint/` | Loop agent | Symlink or copy of best result so far |
| `data/raw/` | `/setup-env` | Downloaded datasets |
| `data/processed/` | Preprocessing script | Transformed, ready-to-use data |
